description.content: Build a purchasable Zazzle product from a template plus partner-supplied images and text.

item.name: Create one or many Zazzle products from a template linkover

request.name: Create one or many Zazzle products from a template linkover

description.content:
Generates a Zazzle product (or a "Templates Buffet" page of products) from a template,
substituting the partner-supplied image URLs and text into the template objects.

Template object parameters are dynamically named after the **URL Parameter Name** assigned to
each template object in the Zazzle design tool. The default naming convention is `image1`,
`image2`, `text1`, `text2`, … incrementing by one per object, producing
`t_image1_iid`, `t_text1_txt`, `t_text1_txtclr`. If a template object was renamed to `photo`,
the parameter becomes `t_photo_iid`.

All image URLs and text values must be URL-encoded.

query.description:
(Required) Type of API request. `Linkover` generates a single product from a single template (`pd`
required). `DesignBlast` generates many products from a store category (`sr` and `cg`
required).
Your Zazzle Associate ID, used for referral attribution.

Template Product ID, taken from the tail of the template product URL. Required when
`ax=Linkover`.

Store ID where the template products reside. Required when `ax=DesignBlast`. Zazzle
documents this value as obtainable only through the link building tool.

Store category ID holding the templates. Required when `ax=DesignBlast`. The default
"New Products" category cannot be used.
Whether the customer may further personalize the generated product on Zazzle.

URL-encoded target for the "Go Back" link on the Templates Buffet page (`ax=DesignBlast`).
The parameter name is case-sensitive and must be spelled `continueUrl`.

Tracking Code identifying where the link was clicked from. Sales carrying a tracking code
appear in the partner's referral history.

Image Code identifying which image from the partner site was used. Purchased products
carrying an image code appear in the partner's royalty history.

URL-encoded link to the image placed into the first template image object. Required when
the template declares an image object. Rename-aware: `t_<objectName>_iid`.
URL-encoded link to the image placed into the second template image object.

Encoded text placed into the first template text object. Required when the template
declares a text object. Rename-aware: `t_<objectName>_txt`.
Encoded text placed into the second template text object.
Text color for the first template text object, as a 6-digit hex color code.

response.name:
The rendered Zazzle product page (single product for `ax=Linkover`) or Templates Buffet
page (many products for `ax=DesignBlast`).

Zazzle renders an in-page error rather than a structured error body. The guide documents
"Zazzle API Error: Image failed to upload" when the image host domain has not been
declared at https://www.zazzle.com/my/associate/domains or the image URL was not encoded.

description.content: (Required) Your Zazzle member account ID, carried in the path segment as `at-<accountId>`.

info.name: Zazzle Create-a-Product Create a Product API

description.content:
The Zazzle Create-a-Product API is a URL "linkover" API. A partner builds a GET link that carries
their Zazzle member account ID, a template product ID (or a store + category ID), and one
parameter/value pair per template object (image or text). Zazzle renders a finished, purchasable
product from the template using the supplied content.

Two modes are selected with the `ax` parameter:

* `Linkover` — **1 to 1**. One link generates one product from one template (`pd`).
* `DesignBlast` — **1 to Many** ("Templates Buffet"). One link generates many products from every
  template in a store category (`sr` + `cg`).

There is no request body, no bearer token, and no JSON envelope — the whole contract is the query
string, and the response is the rendered Zazzle product page (HTML) that the end user lands on.

Prerequisites documented by Zazzle: a Zazzle account, enrollment in the Associates Program,
acceptance of the Create-a-Product API terms, and declaration of the domains the partner's image
URLs will be served from.

**Provenance.** This document was authored by API Evangelist from Zazzle's own published
*Create-A-Product API User Guide & Documentation v3.0 (9/2019)* PDF. Every path, parameter, value
constraint, and required/optional flag below is transcribed from the parameter tables in that
guide. Zazzle does not publish a machine-readable OpenAPI; nothing here is invented.
